events.text:
Built your kitchen herb planter with three hexagonal planter bins on a three-cell base — classic clustered look for a countertop.

**Build:** `piece:0,0,0;full`, `piece:1,0,0;full`, `piece:0,1,0;full` with `bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full`, `bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full`, `bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full`

All bins filled with soil and planted — basil in two bins (`basil-harvest` and `basil-young` for variety) and thyme in one (`thyme-harvest`). The configurator confirms mesh clearance is clear with no errors.

Perfect little L-shaped trio for your kitchen — harvest-ready herbs right where you cook!
